findings: `get_event_loop()` deprecation — Both `_run_text_inference` and `_run_image_inference` call `asyncio.get_event_loop()` inside coroutines. Replace with `asyncio.get_running_loop()`. Raises RuntimeError in Python 3.12.

Per-item latency timestamp is wrong — `latency_ms` is stamped inside the per-item for-loop so results[0].latency_ms ≈ 0 and only the last item reflects true batch latency. Assign `total_latency_ms` (computed after the loop) to every ModerationResult.

No `fetch_failed` flag on image fallback — a zero-pixel substitution for a failed image fetch is indistinguishable from a legitimately all-dark image. Add `image_fetch_failed: bool` to ModerationResult and set it in the zero-fill branch.

Warmup makes unconditional outbound HTTP requests — `warmup.py` hits https://picsum.photos/224 on every startup with no way to disable it. Will block or fail in air-gapped CI. Add an `image_url` override parameter or a `skip_image_warmup` flag.

No tests — zero test files in the repository. The ONNX stubs in export_onnx_stubs.py make fully deterministic unit tests feasible without GPU or real weights. Add tests covering the concurrency path, the zero-vector fallback, and latency field correctness.
